name: revival
description: 2016-style revival: AlphaBlox-derived web frontend, clean API, PostgreSQL, launcher, RFD v347.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @revival/shared && npm run build -w @revival/database && npm run build -w @revival/api
scripts.test: npm run build -w @revival/shared && npm run build -w @revival/database && npm test -w @revival/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @revival/shared && npm run build -w @revival/database && npm run typecheck -w @revival/api
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @revival/shared && npm run build -w @revival/database && npm run dev -w @revival/api
